description: Every battle action: spells, abilities, break arts, items, traps and the base attacks. Hits are in action-hits.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Semantic identity: action.<name>, numbered when names repeat.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The name as the game shows it: ordinary spaces, {level} for the level glyph. It must encode to at most 23 game-text bytes.

columns.name: legacy_id
columns.description: The original table index, which saves, scripts and the learning catalog still use. Runs from 0 to 255 without gaps.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: What the action is. Spells spend MP, abilities RISK, break arts HP and weapon-pp actions the equipped weapon's PP; items and traps spend nothing here, and a base attack's cost comes from the weapon. No shipped action is weapon-pp.

columns.name: category
columns.description: How the action picks and filters its targets.

columns.name: cost
columns.description: How much of the kind's resource one use spends; 255 on the base attack means the weapon decides.

columns.name: recovery_delay
columns.description: The delay before the actor acts again: the actor waits (this + its recovery bonus) * 256 / 35 battle updates. 255 means the equipped weapon's delay; actions 22-53 add no delay.

columns.name: camera_zoom
columns.description: How the combat camera frames the action.

columns.name: effect_id
columns.description: The original effect table slot that presents the action; not yet named.

columns.name: range_x
columns.description: The targeting volume's extent, 32 world units a step; range_x 255, on the base attacks, takes the attacker's weapon extents (blade range plus reach) and angle instead, keeping range_shape.

columns.name: range_y
columns.description: The targeting volume's extent, 32 world units a step; range_x 255, on the base attacks, takes the attacker's weapon extents (blade range plus reach) and angle instead, keeping range_shape.

columns.name: range_z
columns.description: The targeting volume's extent, 32 world units a step; range_x 255, on the base attacks, takes the attacker's weapon extents (blade range plus reach) and angle instead, keeping range_shape.

columns.name: range_shape
columns.description: The targeting volume's shape; none means no volume.

columns.name: range_angle
columns.description: The volume's pitch, in 11.25-degree steps (1/32 turn).

columns.name: area_range_x
columns.description: The area of effect's extent around its target, 32 world units a step.

columns.name: area_range_y
columns.description: The area of effect's extent around its target, 32 world units a step.

columns.name: area_range_z
columns.description: The area of effect's extent around its target, 32 world units a step.

columns.name: area_shape
columns.description: The area of effect's shape; none means a single target.

columns.name: area_angle
columns.description: The volume's pitch, in 11.25-degree steps (1/32 turn).

columns.name: behavior
columns.description: Flags the battle and AI code read. menu-action actions are chosen from a menu (cancelling targeting returns to it) and are presented with their effect rather than a melee animation; starts-unlocked is the state a new game begins in.
